name: Tucker's Taproom & Smokehouse
description: A barbecue restaurant and taproom on the North Fork with indoor seating, a dog-friendly outdoor beer garden and live music on Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

dancing.notes: Bands and solo players perform, often outside in the beer garden. Some nights feature country-rock bands, and one listing invited guests to wear cowboy hats and boots. We found no reports of a dance floor or of people dancing.

evidence.note: Business listing says there is an indoor room and an outdoor beer garden, with live music every Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
Event listing: country-rock band Audawind on Friday, July 24, 2026, 5-8 PM; cowboy hats and boots encouraged.
Review excerpts mention live music outside during dinner; nothing about dancing.
